entries.title: Quick searches are followed by a thorough one
entries.body: When you type a search on one of your own articles, the quick answer still comes first. Once it has settled for two seconds, or at once if you pressed Enter, a thorough search starts by itself, and a spinner the width of the thorough button takes its place while it runs. If it succeeds, its results replace the quick ones in the same place in the list; if it fails, the quick results stay. A thorough search costs more than a quick one.

entries.title: Passage chat opens beside its paragraph
entries.body: On your own articles, when the notes column is showing and there is room beside the paragraph, a chat about a passage opens as a card next to that paragraph and scrolls with the article. Before, the answer sat in the narrow notes column at a few words a line, or in a panel not tied to the passage. You can collapse the card, and where there is no room chat opens as it did before.

entries.title: Find more runs from the command bar
entries.body: Typing "find more terms" or "more quotes" in the command bar opens Glossary or Quotes and presses its Find more for you. The commands appear on your own articles, only while that list can be added to. Before pressing, the app checks afresh whether a run is already under way, to avoid starting a second paid one beside it.

entries.title: Command bar knows more names for each mode
entries.body: Typing "table of contents", "headings" or "chapters" in the command bar finds Structure; "vocabulary" or "jargon" finds Glossary; "tldr", "gist" or "overview" finds Summary. Every mode has gained more names like these, so you can type the word you would use rather than recall ours.

entries.title: Headings row steps aside when not needed
entries.body: If you have the Experimental features switch on your profile page turned on, the row of headings showing where you are no longer appears in Structure, or while the notes column is on screen. Both already tell you where you are in the piece.

entries.title: Documents added by address share the upload limit
entries.body: A document added by its web address was held to a smaller size limit than an uploaded file; the two limits are the same now. One that is over the limit gets a message saying it is too big, in place of a general failure with a Retry button that could not have worked.
